FROM THE FARM TO THE HIGHWAY AND BEYOND.
Always moving, we are Ever Star Industries.

Driven by Vision. Powered by Strength.

Established in August 2010, Ever Star Industries (Pty) Ltd (ESI) is the sole distributor of Powerstar trucks and Shantui construction and mining equipment in the SADC region of sub-equatorial Africa.​

 

ESI has its headquarters in Centurion and an assembly plant located in the industrial hub of Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal, where the Powerstar ranges are assembled according to international Quality Assurance Standards (ISO 9001).​

 

As leading importers of best-in-class commercial vehicles and construction equipment of unprecedented value, ESI offers reliable, professional sales and a growing dealer and after-sales support service network in South Africa and Southern African countries.​

 

ESI aims not only to be the ‘one-stop-shop’ for mining and construction applications but also to assist in the development of Southern African economies by delivering high-quality vehicles and equipment that provide customers with the optimum return on investment.​

 

Our people, trucks, equipment, servicing philosophy, and vision work in combination to support and understand businesses trading in tough African environments.

ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE

AFTER SALES & SERVICE

Everstar Industries On-Call Roadside Service is available for all our vehicle brands 24 Hours a day, 365 days a year. We will arrange either a technician to repair your vehicle on the spot or for your vehicle to be towed to the nearest dealership for reparations. Terms and conditions apply.

​

Contact the Ever Star Industries Roadside Assist helpline: 023 342 3600 / 087 630 2770 (Powerstar Call Centre) *Landline free of charge. Mobile charges may vary depending on your cellular provider

VIDEO & MORE INFORMATION

PowerTech Telematics – A New Era of Fleet Intelligence

​

Ever Star Industries proudly unveiled its PowerTech telematics system, marking a significant leap forward in fleet management technology. At an exclusive launch event, staff, partners, and industry representatives gathered to witness the debut of a solution designed to put real-time vehicle insights and data directly into the hands of fleet operators.

Powerstar Celebrates a Milestone – 10,000 Trucks StrongReaching 10,000 trucks is a landmark moment in Powerstar’s journey, a testament to the dedication, craftsmanship, and teamwork that drive our success. To commemorate this achievement, Ever Star Industries invited staff from across the company to a special celebration at our facility.​

 

The day brought everyone together to recognise the people behind the brand. The event included a heartfelt gathering where the team’s hard work was honoured, followed by the unveiling of the 10,000th Powerstar truck, a proud moment shared by everyone who made it possible.​From manufacturing to after-sales, every individual has played a part in shaping Powerstar’s legacy.

 

This milestone celebrates not just the trucks we build, but the passion, skill, and collective effort of our people.​Here’s to our team, our partners, and the journey ahead, 10,000 trucks down, and many more to come.
